name: Ace Outside Zone Left
purpose: The same footwork stretched to the sideline. It forces their whole defense to run sideways, and if anybody trips over anybody the back cuts up behind them.

X.rule: Block the defender covering you and screen him away from the sideline.

LT.rule: Reach the man on or outside you. If you cannot reach him, run him past the play.

LG.rule: Reach the man on or outside you and get your head across.

C.rule: Reach playside. If nobody is there, cut off the backside.

RG.rule: Reach playside and cut off anybody chasing.

RT.rule: Block back and cut off pursuit. You are the last one to the ball.

TE.rule: Block back and cut off pursuit. You are the last one to the ball.

W.rule: Block the defender covering you. Get in his way and stay there.

Z.rule: Chase across behind the line and cut off anybody trailing the play.

QB.rule: Open to the playside, hand it deep to the back on the run, then fake the other way.

TB.rule: Take the ball on the run and stretch it toward the sideline. Look inside as you go — the moment a crease opens, plant and go north.

coaching_points: The back's eyes are inside while his feet go outside. That is the hard part — drill it walking.
If their end chases hard down the line, the crease is behind him. Tell the back to expect it.
